categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies private broadcast logic in src/net_processing.cpp and src/private_broadcast.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents a timing side-channel in private transaction relay by ensuring all initial outbound connections complete before teardown. As the description notes, this addresses 'theoretical timing attacks' where receiving a transaction back prematurely aborted initial outbound connections, leaking broadcast activity to network observers.
